checklist.criterion: Emitter is generic over an event map: `NotificationEmitter` (or its replacement) is parameterized by a `Record<string, (...args: any[]) => void>`-shaped type defining `user:created` and `user:deleted`
`on` checks handler against the specific event's signature: `on<K extends keyof T>(event: K, handler: T[K])` (or equivalent) rejects a handler with the wrong parameter shape for that event
`emit` checks args against the specific event's signature: `emit<K extends keyof T>(event: K, ...args: Parameters<T[K]>)` (or equivalent) rejects args with the wrong shape for that event
Compile-error case is demonstrated: A commented-out `emitter.emit("user:created", { id: "1" })` (missing `name`) is included with a note that it fails to compile

No `any` leaks into the public event/handler signatures: `any` may remain only in the generic constraint's own definition (e.g. `(...args: any[]) => void` as the bound), not in how a specific event's handler or args are typed
